newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia unemployment up 12.4 pct in Oct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia unemployment up 12.4 pct in Oct yr/yr.

text.p: Unemployment in Mongolia rose by a year-on-year 12.4 percent in October, official statistics showed on Friday.

The number of unemployed had increased to 53,129 people in October this year from 47,269 in October 1995, the State Statistics Bulletin said. There were 52,948 people unemployed in September of this year.
There was no figure as a percentage of the total workforce.
The bulletin also said the actual jobless total was probably higher as many unemployed people did not register.
